Market today: Mixed signals for your tech/chip heavy book. Strong chip exports from Japan suggest underlying demand, but "Nvidia turmoil" and widespread tech outages are fueling negative sentiment.

Your holdings: SOXL (-78.17%), MUU (-61.79%), SMCI (-44.99%), and SPAL (-44.21%) are in deep trouble. These leveraged positions on margin amplify every drop. QQQ (-8.08%) and SMH (-27.7%) are also flashing "SELL."

Watch: Monitor the broader chip sector closely. The positive export data is a counterpoint to the "Nvidia turmoil" sentiment.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your deeply underwater, leveraged tech/chip positions.
plays: SOXL: This 3X leveraged chip ETF is down 78.17% and on "SELL." Consider trimming or exiting to reduce extreme leverage exposure, especially with "Nvidia turmoil" sentiment.
MUU: Down 61.79% and "SELL." This 2X leveraged MU bull ETF is another high-risk position to consider reducing to protect capital.
CRWD: Despite being up 25.52%, it's on "TRIM." Take some profits here to de-risk and free up capital from your concentrated book.
